change.description: The three personal-work stores share completed-result selection and last-event lookup; prototype and release stores share principal-bound artifact selection. A completed prototype now remains visible while release work is claimed, fails, completes or becomes ready.

measurement.method: sealed PC01 _measure_sources implementation against committed HEAD

discoveries: The first real progression exposed that latest prototype selection returned no artifact after the same durable thread advanced to release_ready.
The corrected selector includes later release phases and their waiting or failure statuses, so an already built prototype remains visible while release work progresses.

A bounded live Eva1 observation separately found six consecutive three-second health timeouts during an autonomous turn followed by recovery without a process restart; this is an open runtime responsiveness issue, not evidence against the Eva2 PostgreSQL progression.
nonClaims: The 75000-line release budget is not yet met.
The PostgreSQL progression used synthetic data in one temporary database and did not touch live Eva data.
This checkpoint does not claim that live Eva1 is latency-stable.
This source consolidation does not itself deploy a new runtime image.
nextRequiredAction: Measure and isolate the live Eva1 event-loop stalls, while continuing PC01 consolidation in Eva2 without weakening the sealed source boundary.
